name: maize-watch-monorepo
description: Maize-Watch IoT Agriculture Monitoring System - Full Stack

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend/web-src/web-public && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend/web-src/web-public && npm install
scripts.postbuild: cp -r frontend/web-src/web-public/dist/* backend/dist/ || xcopy /E /I frontend\web-src\web-public\dist\* backend\dist\
